method: Recall-first sweep: every line beginning <chapter>.<n> (optionally <chapter>.<n>.<m>, with an optional trailing period) was captured with NO title constraint, then classified, then reconciled. Unchanged from checkpoint 115; now a checked-in tool (tools/class12/recallFirstSweep.py) that reproduces the stored 12-chapter result exactly before being applied to Chapter 7.
convergence: At checkpoint 115 two methods built on different assumptions (the recall-first sweep and detector revision 2) agreed on sections for 12 chapters; three revisions of one regex disagreeing was evidence only that it was unreliable. Checkpoint 116 adds a third, independent source: every one of the 13 chapters' sections matches the printed Contents pages by number, title and start folio.
boundarySemantics: start = the heading line; end = the line before the next heading of the same level. When that heading is mid-page the earlier section ends on the same page. A chapter's last section ends on the line before the Miscellaneous Exercise (or Summary where there is none); that end matter is recorded per chapter in CLASS12_MISC_EXERCISE_SCOPES.json.
c1207Correction: Checkpoint 115 ended each section on the page BEFORE the next heading. Where the next heading is mid-page that understated the end by one page; such records keep the old value as c1207EndPdfPage.
historicalComparison: Only after the source-derived count existed was it compared with the remembered figure: the primary-source total and the remembered total coincide. The remembered figure was never an input, a target or a test oracle; agreement is noted, not used as evidence.
